source.title: Dixon Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript (30 Oct 2026), NSE filing

guidance.statement: Mobile volumes (ex-Vivo) of ~33–34M units, with export ramp-up from Q4
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall, VC & MD
guidance.flag: Transcript wording is ambiguous between full-year and H2. H1 was ~17.2M, so FY 33–34M implies a flat H2, while H2 33–34M implies ~50M for the year. FINN tracks it as unresolved.

guidance.statement: Vivo JV to reach ~20–21M units a year once production starts from Q4 FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall

guidance.statement: IT hardware revenue ~₹6,000 Cr this year, rising to ₹15,000–20,000 Cr in a couple of years (ex-servers)
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall / Saurabh Gupta

guidance.statement: Group capex ~₹1,200 Cr in FY27 (~₹700 Cr already spent in H1); similar ₹1,200–1,300 Cr in FY28
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta, CFO

guidance.statement: Display + camera-module businesses to add 80–100 bps to group margins over two years; display margins in high teens next year
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

guidance.statement: IT hardware margins ~2–2.3% at current pricing; +80–100 bps as 25–30% of BOM is backward-integrated
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

guidance.statement: Q Tech (camera modules) revenue ~₹2,500–3,000 Cr next year, margins recovering to 6–7%
guidance.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

delivered.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹21,806 Cr; EBITDA ex-fair-value gain ₹609 Cr; PAT after minority ₹293 Cr
Mobile volumes roughly flat YoY while India's smartphone market fell ~26%; H1 FY27 ~17.2M units
Mobile & EMS revenue ₹20,093 Cr, op. profit ₹509 Cr. Management says growth came from memory-cost pass-through (price), not volume
Washing-machine EBITDA margin ~8.3% vs a usual ~11% (~3 pp hit in H1 from polymer, freight and FX)

analyst_pushback: Mobile volume outlook with smartphone market down sharply
Margin compression from memory costs; lagged pass-through in appliances
Working-capital build and H1 cash burn; timing of PLI receipts
Sustainability of memory-driven revenue if component prices reverse
